title: The Parrot's Perfect Plan
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, cute expressive characters with big eyes, exaggerated funny facial expressions, vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16

narrator.look: A kind, warm female storyteller. Invisible, but her voice sets the tone.

Rohan.look: 20 years old, fair skin, messy dark hair, wide eyes, anxious but kind face. Wears an oversized faded blue t-shirt and grey sweatpants.

Mithu.look: Bright green parrot, sleek feathers, short curved beak, small black eyes, a red ring around its neck. Sits on a wooden perch next to Rohan's desk.

scenes.image: [[Rohan]], face pale, wide-eyed, clutching his head, surrounded by open books on a messy desk. A clock on the wall shows very late night.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: OMG! Kal exam hai, maine kuch nahi padha!
scenes.say: ओएमजी! कल एग्जाम है, मैंने कुछ नहीं पढ़ा!

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Rohan]]'s panicked face, sweat beading on his forehead.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Sab toh bhool gaya, ab kya hoga?
scenes.say: सब तो भूल गया, अब क्या होगा?

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] on its perch, head tilted, observing [[Rohan]] with a curious, slightly mischievous look.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Rohan ka exam tha, aur uski planning zero thi.
scenes.say: रोहन का एग्जाम था, और उसकी प्लानिंग ज़ीरो थी।

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] grabs a thick textbook, opens it to a random page, looking utterly lost.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Theorie of Relativity... yeh kya hai?
scenes.say: थ्योरी ऑफ़ रिलेटिविटी... ये क्या है?

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] sighs dramatically, resting his head on the book. [[Mithu]] mimics his sigh faintly.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Uff, itna syllabus... kaise hoga?
scenes.say: उफ़, इतना सिलेबस... कैसे होगा?

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] picks up his phone, eyes glued to the screen, a slight smile forming.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Ek quick reel dekh leta hoon, bas ek!
scenes.say: एक क्विक रील देख लेता हूँ, बस एक!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] hops on its perch, looking towards the phone screen with interest.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Reel! Reel!
scenes.say: रील! रील!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] laughs nervously, puts phone down, tries to focus on the book.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Nahi, nahi, focus Rohan, focus!
scenes.say: नहीं, नहीं, फोकस रोहन, फोकस!

scenes.image: Close-up on [[Rohan]]'s eyes darting between the book and his phone.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Par padhai se zyada, distractions bula rahe the.
scenes.say: पर पढ़ाई से ज़्यादा, डिस्ट्रैक्शन्स बुला रहे थे।

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] yawns widely, stretching his arms above his head.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Thodi neend aa rahi hai, kya karun?
scenes.say: थोड़ी नींद आ रही है, क्या करूँ?

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] closes its eyes briefly, then opens one eye to peek at [[Rohan]].
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Neend! Neend!
scenes.say: नींद! नींद!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] gets up, walks to the fridge, opens it, light illuminates his face.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Kuch khaane ko mile toh energy milegi.
scenes.say: कुछ खाने को मिले तो एनर्जी मिलेगी।

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] pulls out a large pizza box, a triumphant grin on his face.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Ah, pizza! The ultimate study fuel!
scenes.say: आह, पिज्ज़ा! द अल्टीमेट स्टडी फ्यूल!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] takes a huge bite of pizza, cheese stretching. [[Mithu]] watches intently.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Pizza! Yummy!
scenes.say: पिज्ज़ा! यम्मी!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] is back at his desk, surrounded by pizza crumbs, looking slightly bloated.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Study session se zyada, yeh feast session ban gaya.
scenes.say: स्टडी सेशन से ज़्यादा, ये फ़ीस्ट सेशन बन गया।

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] tries to read, but his eyes keep drifting to a video game controller on his bed.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Ek round game khel loon? Mood fresh ho jayega.
scenes.say: एक राउंड गेम खेल लूँ? मूड फ़्रेश हो जाएगा।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] chirps excitedly, flapping its wings slightly, looking at the controller.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Game! Game!
scenes.say: गेम! गेम!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] is now fully engrossed in a video game, shouting at the screen.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Headshot! Take that, villain!
scenes.say: हेडशॉट! टेक दैट, विलेन!

scenes.image: Hours later, [[Rohan]] is slumped in his chair, game controller on the floor, looking exhausted.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Subah hone wali thi, aur padhai zero thi.
scenes.say: सुबह होने वाली थी, और पढ़ाई ज़ीरो थी।

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] looks at the clock in horror, then at the pile of unread books.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Oh no, time is running out!
scenes.say: ओह नो, टाइम इज़ रनिंग आउट!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] vigorously shakes his head, then splashes water on his face.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: No more distractions! Ab bas padhai!
scenes.say: नो मोर डिस्ट्रैक्शन्स! अब बस पढ़ाई!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] gulps down a cup of black coffee, making a face.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Kadwi hai par zaroori hai!
scenes.say: कड़वी है पर ज़रूरी है!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] tries to read intensely, furrowing his brow. His eyes are bloodshot.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Electro-magnetic fields... Maxwell's equations...
scenes.say: इलेक्ट्रो-मैग्नेटिक फील्ड्स... मैक्सवेल की इक्वेशन्स...

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] mimics Rohan's mumbling, slightly off-key.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Fields! Maxwell! Equations!
scenes.say: फील्ड्स! मैक्सवेल! इक्वेशन्स!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] blinks, looking around, confused. He shakes his head.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Yeh mera dimaag chal raha hai ya kya?
scenes.say: ये मेरा दिमाग़ चल रहा है या क्या?

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] tries to write notes, but his hand is shaky and his writing is illegible.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Concentrate, Rohan! Last chance!
scenes.say: कंसन्ट्रेट, रोहन! लास्ट चांस!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] slams the book shut in frustration, face contorted in despair.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Mujhse nahi hoga! I give up!
scenes.say: मुझसे नहीं होगा! आई गिव अप!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] looks at [[Rohan]] with wide, understanding eyes, then glances at the books.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Rohan ne haar maan li thi.
scenes.say: रोहन ने हार मान ली थी।

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] collapses onto his bed, pulling a blanket over his head.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Bas ek chhoti si power nap...
scenes.say: बस एक छोटी सी पावर नैप...

scenes.image: Close-up on the clock, showing time quickly passing, dawn light creeping in.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Samay tezi se bhaag raha tha.
scenes.say: समय तेज़ी से भाग रहा था।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] flies off its perch, landing softly on the desk, near the books.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Par Mithu, uski aankhon mein ek chamak thi.
scenes.say: पर मिठू, उसकी आँखों में एक चमक थी।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] taps a textbook with its beak, then looks at a closed laptop.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Exam! Exam!
scenes.say: एग्जाम! एग्जाम!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] pecks at the laptop, then looks around, making sure [[Rohan]] is asleep.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Uske paas ek secret plan tha.
scenes.say: उसके पास एक सीक्रेट प्लान था।

scenes.image: A close-up of [[Mithu]]'s beak gently tapping the laptop's power button. The screen flickers to life.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mithu ne laptop on kar diya.
scenes.say: मिठू ने लैपटॉप ऑन कर दिया।

scenes.image: The laptop screen shows an online lecture playing, [[Mithu]] intently watching.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Lecture! Suno!
scenes.say: लेक्चर! सुनो!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] is sitting on the keyboard, head tilted, listening to the lecture.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Rohan jab gaaflat mein tha, Mithu padh raha tha.
scenes.say: रोहन जब ग़ाफ़लत में था, मिठू पढ़ रहा था।

scenes.image: A montage: [[Mithu]] watching lectures, pecking at notes, flying to a whiteboard and mimicking writing.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Usne sab lessons absorb kar liye the.
scenes.say: उसने सब लेसन्स एब्जॉॉर्ब कर लिए थे।

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Mithu]]'s intense, focused expression, eyes wide.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Physics! Chemistry! Maths!
scenes.say: फ़िज़िक्स! केमिस्ट्री! मैथ्स!

scenes.image: Sunlight streams through the window. [[Rohan]] stirs, slowly waking up, groggy.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Uhh... kitne baj gaye?
scenes.say: उह्ह... कितने बज गए?

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] sits up abruptly, eyes wide with panic as he remembers the exam.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Exam! Oh God, I'm doomed!
scenes.say: एग्जाम! ओह गॉड, आइ'एम डूमड!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] rushes to his desk, looking frantically through his books.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Kuch toh yaad aa jaa, please!
scenes.say: कुछ तो याद आ जा, प्लीज़!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] flies to [[Rohan]]'s shoulder, looking very calm and composed.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Tabhi, Mithu ne Rohan ko surprise kiya.
scenes.say: तभी, मिठू ने रोहन को सरप्राइज़ किया।

scenes.image: Close-up on [[Mithu]] whispering into [[Rohan]]'s ear, a serious expression.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Newton's First Law: Inertia!
scenes.say: न्यूटन का फर्स्ट लॉ: इनर्शिया!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] freezes, eyes wide open, turning slowly to look at [[Mithu]].
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Mithu? Tune kya bola?
scenes.say: मिठू? तूने क्या बोला?

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] puffs out its chest proudly, pointing its beak towards a textbook.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: E = mc squared! Energy, mass!
scenes.say: ई इक्वल्स एम सी स्क्वेयर्ड! एनर्जी, मास!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] stares at [[Mithu]] in utter disbelief, mouth agape.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Yeh... yeh kaise?

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] flies to a specific page in a book, tapping a complex diagram with its beak.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Photosynthesis process, carbon dioxide!
scenes.say: फोटोसिंथेसिस प्रोसेस, कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] grabs the book, looks at the diagram, then back at [[Mithu]] with dawning realization.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Tune... tune meri lectures suni?
scenes.say: तूने... तूने मेरी लेक्चर्स सुनी?

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] nods its head smugly, a tiny wink.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Main sab jaanta hoon, Rohan!
scenes.say: मैं सब जानता हूँ, रोहन!

scenes.image: Close-up of Rohan's face, a mix of shock, amusement, and a tiny bit of awe.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Rohan ko vishwas nahi ho raha tha.
scenes.say: रोहन को विश्वास नहीं हो रहा था।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] then mimics Rohan's initial panicked sighs and distraction noises.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Uff! Reel! Game!
scenes.say: उफ़! रील! गेम!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] slaps his forehead, laughing at himself.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Tu toh mujhse zyada smart hai!
scenes.say: तू तो मुझसे ज़्यादा स्मार्ट है!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] flies to Rohan's pen, takes it in its beak, and gestures towards a blank paper.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Write! Write! Exam time!
scenes.say: राइट! राइट! एग्जाम टाइम!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] quickly starts writing down notes, guided by [[Mithu]]'s chirps and pointers.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mithu ne uski sari neend udda di thi.
scenes.say: मिठू ने उसकी सारी नींद उड़ा दी थी।

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] is furiously writing, [[Mithu]] on his shoulder, occasionally whispering answers.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Formula! Principle! Definition!
scenes.say: फ़ॉर्मूला! प्रिंसिपल! डेफ़िनिशन!

scenes.image: A rapid montage of Rohan writing, Mithu pointing, Rohan's eyes lighting up.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Last minute mein, miracle ho raha tha.
scenes.say: लास्ट मिनट में, मिरैकल हो रहा था।

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] runs out the door, backpack on, looking determined. [[Mithu]] waves from the window.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Thank you, Mithu! Best teacher ever!
scenes.say: थैंक यू, मिठू! बेस्ट टीचर एवर!

scenes.image: Close-up on [[Mithu]] smiling smugly, watching Rohan leave.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Pass ho jaayega ab!
scenes.say: पास हो जाएगा अब!

scenes.image: Later, [[Rohan]] returns home, looking tired but relieved. [[Mithu]] is waiting.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Exam theek gaya! Thanks to you!
scenes.say: एग्जाम ठीक गया! थैंक्स टू यू!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] gives [[Mithu]] a big hug, careful not to crush him.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Rohan ko samajh aa gaya tha.
scenes.say: रोहन को समझ आ गया था।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] now sits on a stack of textbooks, wearing tiny spectacles, looking like a professor.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Padhai karo! Varna fail ho jaoge!
scenes.say: पढ़ाई करो! वरना फेल हो जाओगे!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] bursts into laughter, pointing at [[Mithu]].
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Tu toh asli genius hai, Mithu!
scenes.say: तू तो असली जीनियस है, मिठू!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] winks at the camera, then takes a bite of Rohan's snack.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Next exam ka plan bhi ready hai!
scenes.say: नेक्स्ट एग्जाम का प्लान भी रेडी है!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] looks bewildered, then shakes his head, smiling.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Rohan ko apni neend ka pachtawa tha.
scenes.say: रोहन को अपनी नींद का पछतावा था।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] is happily perched on a book, nibbling a cookie, looking proud.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Lesson learned: Kabhi pet ko underestimate mat karo!
scenes.say: लेसन लर्न्ड: कभी पेट को अंडरएस्टीमेट मत करो!

scenes.image: [[Rohan]] is now meticulously organizing his desk, looking at his parrot.
scenes.speaker: Rohan
scenes.line: Ab toh time pe padhna hi padega!
scenes.say: अब तो टाइम पे पढ़ना ही पड़ेगा!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] holds up a tiny report card with an 'A' grade, showing it to the camera.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Maine toh top kar liya!
scenes.say: मैंने तो टॉप कर लिया!

scenes.image: Rohan is laughing heartily, patting Mithu. Mithu is preening.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Kiska exam plan better tha, Rohan ka ya Mithu ka?
scenes.say: किसका एग्जाम प्लान बेटर था, रोहन का या मिठू का?

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] sitting on Rohan's shoulder, both smiling broadly at the camera.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Tumhara sabse funny exam experience kya hai?
scenes.say: तुम्हारा सबसे फ़नी एग्जाम एक्सपीरियंस क्या है?

caption: My Lazy Parrot Had a Secret Exam Plan 🤫
yt_title: My Lazy Parrot Had a Secret Exam Plan 🤫
description: My exam was tomorrow, and I hadn't studied anything! Little did I know, my pet parrot Mithu had a hilarious strategy. What's the craziest thing you've done to avoid studying?
comment_question: What's the craziest thing you've done to avoid studying?
